title: Amulet of Branding
summary: Use a Bonus Action once per Long Rest to brand a target and make it vulnerable to a selected physical damage type: Bludgeoning, Slashing, or Piercing.

fields.Effect: Brand the Weak is a Bonus Action once per Long Rest. Choose Bludgeoning, Slashing, or Piercing vulnerability for a target within 60 ft. It lasts 3 turns or until the target takes damage.
fields.Base value: 125 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Reported interaction: The pinned item notes that the vulnerability appears to persist through a single damaging instance, including applicable simultaneous main-hand and off-hand strikes.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
